# FLX-6111: a name for a column that has no FLUID SQL/1 type

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

FLUID SQL/1 types six kinds of column (RFC-data-rules.md §2.3). A column declared as time, interval, money, json, array, struct, map, binary or any other type outside that table cannot be named in an expression.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6111
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
